profile.headline: Senior Gameplay Engineer at WB Games / Avalanche
profile.summary:
I'm currently working on a solo project, but still very interested in employment.

As technical director my primary responsibility is to make sure everything goes smoothly. In addition to managing people this requires production, game design, and programming ability. I take part in all three of these on a regular basis. As a manager, I believe in being relatively hands off. It is my preference to give people the knowledge and tools they need for success, taking a step back, and trusting that they will be the professionals that we hired them to be. I believe this level of autonomy is imperative for creative professionals to do their best work. I'm a certified product owner and have a proven track record of delivering quality software on time and within budget.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
● Hands-on development of core gameplay systems for an open-world sandbox game in UE5. 
● Prototyped and iterated on gameplay features, including UI and AI.
positions.insights: Skills: Agentic Workflows · 3D Graphics · Blender · UIX · C++ · Git · Agentic AI Development · Xbox · UE5 · UI · Game Programming · Gameplay Programming · Character Animation · Lighting · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Senior Gameplay Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and implemented a dynamic content placement system in UE5, allowing designers to swap encounters into world locations using tags and map metadata. 
● Built custom Unreal editor tools to improve iteration speed, validation, and content authoring workflows
● Developed a UE5 spell-check plugin integrated into internal ImGui tooling, improving content quality and usability.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description:
● Implemented and maintained gameplay-adjacent build and production automation systems for Warframe WeGame using MongoDB, Python, C++, and Slack.
● Fixed and modernized XInput and Steam Input implementations across the game.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Management · Python (Programming Language) · MongoDB · PHP

positions.title: Senior Gameplay Engineer
positions.description:
● Created a multiplayer-capable projectile scripting system for Blueprint, empowering designers to author complex combat behaviors. 
● Integrated WWise audio and implemented a combat-aware audio importance and ducking system.

positions.title: Technical Director at ArenaNet, LLC
positions.description:
● Directed a 20 minute gameplay prototype to completion. 
● Created a technical roadmap to help drive the technologies being developed for a proprietary engine, leading an engineering team of 13 people.

positions.title: Lead Gameplay Programmer for Guild Wars 2
positions.description:
● Product owner for Guild Wars 2 China. Drove development operations for localization and systems required to satisfy the Chinese governmental restrictions/requirements on video games. We had a flawless launch in 3 data centers from locations across the globe. 
● Product owner for Guild Wars 2 Play For Free. Not only did I drive the development of play for free, but I also anticipated its need ahead of our marketing department. Guild Wars 2 Play for Free is one of the best free to play experiences to date.  The release of Play For Free was coordinated to activate as the founder of the company was announcing the product via live stream. We were able to push Play For Free live the minute it was being announced. 
● Product owner Guild Wars 2 gameplay platform team. Managed 13 engineers throughout the studio with 6 on the gameplay platform team. This role required that I coordinate requests from over 15 stakeholders and prioritize those requests over the product as a whole. Gameplay platform was critical to the timely release of Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
● Started work on Guild Wars 2 from the ground up
● Created the infrastructure the designers use to script world boss encounters.
● Created the composite dye system. This was used for characters as well as clothing. 
● Created the mechanisms for all interactables and scriptable world objects in the game, including things like capture points and other event objectives. 
● Created the Guild Wars 2 character creation system and UI. 
● Created the public event system used for nearly every encounter in the game, as well as helped design the heart encounters that help draw players to the public quests. 
● Made significant improvements to the scripting system, including adding variables, subroutines, and for loops. ● Created the system used to script and place effects. 
● Created the system used to efficiently store character progress.

positions.title: Engine/Lead/Gameplay Programmer
positions.description:
● Sole gameplay programmer assigned to Digimon Rumble Arena 2 until the game had progressed to the production phase. 
● Built a working prototype using their proprietary engine in my first few weeks at Amaze Entertainment.

positions.title: Gameplay Programmer
positions.description: ● Worked on the track placement system for Rails Across America and the diplomacy system.

positions.title: Co-Founder/Programmer
positions.description: ● Created an email to SMS solution. The company was sold to Infospace.com.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: ● Updating/debugging software for Y2K.  Wrote various tools for the Windows 2000 resource kit.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: ● Created a help desk support software package.  This involved integrating the phone systems with a customer tracking database using Java and MSSQL.
